testsuite.name: Stonebridge Fleet Auto - quote lifecycle checks (SOT-prose section 5).

testcase.name: a valid submission is recorded and awaits rating
a submission with no vehicles is rejected as invalid input, not priced
a submission with a field outside its documented domain is rejected
rating prices the quote per the rating rules and stamps the rating date
rating an excluded risk (young driver) records the decline with no premium
rating a fleet with out-of-state operations records the decline with no premium
a declined quote is terminal - it can be neither re-rated nor bound
an expired quote refuses binding until re-rated; re-rating restores it
a quote is still bindable on day 60 exactly (working assumption FLEET-OQ-004)
a high-premium quote is referred - priced, but not bindable before approval
approval clears a referred quote for binding without changing the premium
binding a rated unexpired quote issues the policy
a bound quote can be neither bound again nor re-rated
approving a non-referred quote is refused (working assumption FLEET-OQ-005)
an unknown quote id is a 404 on every lifecycle verb
